title: Values of the tableau gates
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input and output whose input-head and work-tape-head positions at each time depend only on the input length. Let $x$ be a finite Boolean string of length $n$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Evaluating the tableau gates for $M,n,t$ with $x$ as the input gives $x_i$ at each input index $i$; the next two vertices have values false and true, respectively. For every time $s<t$, the values at the tableau block for time $s$ form the encoding of the machine configuration at time $s$ on input $x$, and the tableau vertex for time $s$ records whether the machine has emitted true at some time strictly before $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is oblivious: equal-length inputs give the same input-head and work-tape-head positions at every time
